title: Integration
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM

e Streetlights (for example, address, property status, operation types)

The energy price is calculated in connection with the burning hour calendar.

e Heating installations (for example, device category description, charging control, special agreements)

e Container

Integration

Integrated Components and Their Functions

The following components are integrated to control reading and billing:

Component

Regional Structure (ISU-BFRS)

Portioning and Scheduling (ISU-BFPS)

Rate Structure (ISU-BIBDRS)

Installation Structure (ISU-DMDIIS)

Profiles

Function

For streets or cities, you can define the temperature area and meter

reading unit in the regional structure, and copy these default values
to the installation.

The scheduling defines the meter reading dates. They depend on
the meter reading unit to which the installation is assigned.

The rate according to which the installation is billed depends on the

general rate category to which the installation is assigned. You can
use the individual rate category of the installation to override the

general rate category (for example, if you have made customer-
specific agreements).

The registers and rate data of devices that are installed in the
installation are maintained in the installation structure.

You can assign load profiles to an installation. The assignment refers to the identification of the corresponding load profile.

Regional Structure Default

You can use the regional structure defaults to have the system suggest the franchise contract. For this, you select the time slice to

be processed and choose |Edit } Region Defaults

Deregulation Data

The entries that you make in the Deregulation Fields of the installation affect the determination of the Deregulation Scenario.

Other

You can change the date Valid From or the premise of a utility installation provided that the utility installation has not yet been
assigned a contract and no devices have been installed in the utility installation.

Point of Delivery (PoD)
